sections.heading: 3.1.  Header Format
sections.relevance: TCP's source and destination port fields are in the complete TCP header; the packet next-protocol and header completeness still come from the observer.

sections.heading: Format
sections.relevance: The UDP header format includes two port fields; selecting UDP and checking completeness are observation facts.

sections.heading: 3.2.  Discussion
sections.relevance: Fragments must be reassembled before a complete transport attribution is available; a lone fragment is incomplete evidence.

sections.heading: 4.5.  Fragment Header
sections.relevance: IPv6 fragment offset identifies a piece of an original packet, not a validated complete transport header.

sections.heading: 3.5.  Establishing a Connection
sections.relevance: Connection opening requires related sequence-bearing segments and acknowledgment; one isolated flag is insufficient.
